summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Carle Vernet, a French painter. It gives his full name, Antoine Charles Horace Vernet, and his dates (14 August 1758 to 17 November 1836). It also places him within his family: the youngest child of Claude Joseph Vernet and the father of Horace Vernet.
one_line: French painter Carle Vernet (1758–1836), youngest child of Claude Joseph Vernet and father of Horace Vernet.
key_facts: Carle Vernet's full name was Antoine Charles Horace Vernet.
